finding: Original CSRS ranks current stress. Original evaluation labels the 30 sessions **after** breaks. Neither is inherently a forecast of the preceding onset window.
required_response: Define and score future-target probabilities separately; retain CSRS as a diagnostic.

finding: Original batched Hamilton filtering recomputes the emission variance floor from a sample containing the rest of the forecast block. Future values can change earlier filtered probabilities.
required_response: Freeze every preprocessing/regularization statistic at training cutoff; add full-pipeline suffix-perturbation regression before trusting that path.

finding: Legacy `mean_lead_time` credits the earliest threshold crossing anywhere before an onset, without a bounded window or actual persistence test.
required_response: Replace predictive reporting with explicit event-window matching, misses, and episode starts.

finding: CSRS's linear asymmetric calibration is not a proper probability loss and favors extreme simplex allocations.
required_response: Fit probabilities with proper scoring loss; apply action costs to the alert policy.

finding: Six remembered labels, one unresolved; four assessable non-tariff alert events. Related daily labels are not independent crises.
required_response: Freeze objective event definitions and a new evaluation protocol; preserve named events as case studies.

finding: Combined loss calibration drifts and pillars show little incremental value beyond stronger baselines.
required_response: Evaluate adaptive calibration and matched baseline comparisons before new complexity.

finding: MP exceedance fraction can decrease when the market becomes more dominated by one common mode. Gaussian independence p-values are not crisis probabilities.
required_response: Separate dependence detection from instability; prioritize conditional spectral changes on an appropriate null.

finding: Daily RMT averages stocks into ten hash portfolios; median fast leading share is 0.842. This differs substantially from the 500-stock pillar.
required_response: Rebuild fast/slow constituent or economic-sector panels, alongside the retained original estimator.

finding: Original Hawkes excitation has approximately one-bar half-life in the prior study; it does not establish 15-session warning skill. Changed jump extraction has not regenerated that evidence.
required_response: Re-estimate corrected streams and test horizon-specific intensity/mark features.

finding: Pooled jump signs are dependent; the downside gate uses an independent-binomial null and an estimated baseline treated as fixed.
required_response: Validate by session-cluster resampling or a suitable overdispersed model; report continuous evidence rather than relying on a hard gate.

finding: Daily Hamilton has 7 nonconverged fits out of 82; minimum fitted state occupancy is 0.58%. High-volatility state is not a named-crisis probability.
required_response: Introduce declared convergence/identification eligibility and tail-aware forecasts.

finding: Conditional CSRS `a'Pa` is repaired, but uncertainty in weights, regime probabilities, ECDF reference distributions, and parameters is not included. Default diagonal filter does not estimate cross-pillar dependence.
required_response: Validate uncertainty against its actual estimand; do not label the interval a future-loss interval.

finding: Snapshot is not an as-published archive; membership coverage varies from 212 to 500; synthetic target is not the official market index.
required_response: Build an immutable target/input ledger with publication times, membership, adjustments, and coverage.

finding: Existing episode scoring rewards any overlap with a positive day. One long alert can cover events and many unhelpful days. Calibration budgets are exceeded in onset replay.
required_response: Evaluate fresh alerts, active coverage, duration, precision, costs, and misses jointly.

finding: `ln(2)/(1-p)` is an approximation to a constant-transition spell half-life, not a general liquidity-recovery forecast.
required_response: Report exact spell-duration quantities or a specified first-passage forecast.

finding: Original Hamilton's default `fit()`/auto-fit uses smoothing. Causal callers must select and fit correctly.
required_response: Make diagnostic versus forecast eligibility explicit at the boundary; preserve historical smoothed artifacts as descriptive only.

finding: Original Hamilton draws constant-transition restarts as if their parameters were unconstrained logits. All four default-seed draws imply invalid transition probabilities.
required_response: Construct legal simplex transitions, or draw in the actual unconstrained parameterization with the correct fit flag.

finding: Original Hawkes returns a convergence flag that `estimate_state` does not check; original Hamilton can fall back to a nonconverged fit when every start fails.
required_response: Separate numerical fit status from usable emissions and record all failed/rejected attempts.
